content: उपविश् €6 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To sit down, take a seat; एवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् <ls>Bg. 1. 47</ls>. .²2 To sit near to, wait upon. .²3 To pitch a camp, encamp. .²4 To go down, set (as the sun). .²5 To enter upon, practise; as प्रायम् उपविशति; so अनशनोपविष्ट. .²6 To abstain from food, fast; सोऽप्युक्त्वैवमुपाविशत् <ls>Bk. 7. 75</ls>. .²7 To seize, take possession of. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to sit down, place or set down.
